column13: Offset $412 first described unfinished skip-most-functions option; then NOT USED; subsequently SetGsCrt toggle. Current page includes only later meaning. Do not use old value mapping in current instructions.

Older USB and SMB guides call the compressed image POPS_IOP.PAK; 2017 changes replace with POPS_IOX.PAK. The current recovery only describes POPS_IOX.PAK. Textual change, not evidence of binary contents or compatibility.

Old VCD page linked to redump.org/cues/psx and instructed that BIN and CUE filenames match, with caution about track metadata. Removed by July 27; absent from the current vcd.md. Do not recommend a downloaded CUE without confirming disc/track structure.
Historical pfs-scripts.7z download was superseded or relinked; the command pfs.bat hddX: __.POPS *.VCD and deba5er/ElPatas credit remain in recovered pfsshell.md; binary provenance still unresolved.
